# The package server

This section is for administrators, developers and hosting companies who want to know where the setup wizard,
the kickstarter and `exp:install` get their site packages from. It answers: what the package server is, what is on
it, how a package gets there, which settings point an installation at it, and what to do without it.

> **Tip**
> Built a site package that others could use? 7x and the Exponential Foundation strongly encourage you to submit it
> by pull request to the repository behind the package server:
> [Contribute your site package](../contribute-your-site-package.md).

## Contents

1. [In short](#in-short)
2. [The pages of this section](#the-pages-of-this-section)
3. [Which page for which question](#which-page-for-which-question)
4. [The addresses at a glance](#the-addresses-at-a-glance)
5. [Related pages](#related-pages)

## In short

- The **package server** is a static HTTPS web site:
  [exponential.packages.exponential.earth](https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/). Nothing on it runs
  code; it serves files.
- It has one folder per Exponential release, `exponential/6.0/<version>/`, each with an `index.xml`, the
  `.ezpkg` archives and a `thumbnails/` folder.
- An installation reads `<RemotePackagesIndexURL>/index.xml`, set in `settings/package.ini [RepositorySettings]`.
  For 6.0.15 that is `https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15`.
- The site is published by GitHub Pages from the repository
  [se7enxweb/exponential.packages.exponential.earth](https://github.com/se7enxweb/exponential.packages.exponential.earth);
  a GitHub Actions workflow adds the directory listing pages.
- The packages are built from source repositories such as
  [se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage) and
  [se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage).
- The 6.0.15 folder holds 44 packages, twelve of them site packages.
- Without the server, an installation can use a local `index.xml` and packages already imported, or a mirror of
  your own.

## Which page for which question

| You want to ... | Read |
|---|---|
| see which packages an installation can choose from | [What is on the package server](what-is-on-the-package-server.md) |
| look at the files yourself | [Browsing the package server in a browser](browsing-the-package-server-in-a-browser.md) |
| check a package before you trust it | [Downloading a package by hand](downloading-a-package-by-hand.md) |
| install on a server without internet access | [Offline installs and mirrors](offline-installs-and-mirrors.md) |
| understand an error in the Site package step | [When the package server cannot be reached](when-the-package-server-cannot-be-reached.md) |
| point an installation at another server | [Package server settings](package-server-settings.md), then [Pointing a site at your package server](../your-own/pointing-a-site-at-your-package-server.md) |
| run a package server of your own | [Running your own package server](../your-own/running-your-own-package-server.md) |
| get your package onto the shared server | [Contribute your site package](../contribute-your-site-package.md) |

## The addresses at a glance

| What | Address |
|---|---|
| The package server | <https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/> |
| All release folders of 6.0 | <https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/> |
| The 6.0.15 release folder | <https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/> |
| The 6.0.15 package index | <https://exponential.packages.exponential.earth/exponential/6.0/6.0.15/index.xml> |
| The repository behind it | <https://github.com/se7enxweb/exponential.packages.exponential.earth> |
| The setting that names it | `settings/package.ini [RepositorySettings] RemotePackagesIndexURL` |
| Where downloaded packages land | `var/storage/packages/7x/<name>/` |
